principles: Free users use local AI by default; no server inference cost for routine questions.
Pro users get server AI only for tasks where long-term context materially improves the answer.
Send compact summaries and relevant memories rather than the full raw history.
Use monthly credits/soft quotas so worst-case inference cost is bounded.
Never put provider API keys in the client.

example_cost_control.target_inference_cost_ratio: <= 20% of subscription revenue before payment/store/tax overhead
example_cost_control.note: Actual pricing should be recalculated from the chosen model provider's current token prices.
